recognize: an animal the prompt doesn't already have, named by the part's own words: "pet", "dog", "old cat", "animal".
reader.heading: For an animal:

questions.ask: what it is, in one word from its words ("pet", "dog", "cat").
questions.required: part {n}: an animal's noun is one of its own words, and "{value}" is not among the words "{words}"

questions.needs_message: part {n}: an animal needs something to vary, from species, breed, life_stage
questions.ask: what changes from image to image, from: species (what kind of animal, when the words leave it open: "pet", "animal"), breed (when the words name one kind that has a breed or coat list below: "dog", "kitten"; never beside species), life_stage (baby, juvenile, adult, elderly).
when species varies, the kind of animal the words call for, from: {options}. "pet" is "pet"; "farm animal" is "farm". "" when the words call for any animal ("animal", "creature").
the id of that kind's breed or coat list below, or "".
for each of those the words settle, the words that settle it, copied exactly: {"life_stage": "old"}; a young animal's own word settles its life stage: "kitten" or "puppy" is {"life_stage": "kitten"}.

draws.about: what kind of animal the {noun} is
